def test_auth_signup_and_login():
    username = "user_" + "".join(random.choices(string.ascii_lowercase + string.digits, k=8))
    password = "password123"

    # Signup
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/auth/signup"), json={"user": username, "password": password}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert "token" in resp.json()
    token = resp.json()["token"]

    # Follow-up GET
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}
    resp_me = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/user/me"), headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp_me.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp_me.status_code}: {resp_me.text}"
    assert resp_me.json()["user"] == username

    # Login
    resp_login = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/auth/login"), json={"user": username, "password": password}, timeout=10)
    assert resp_login.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp_login.status_code}: {resp_login.text}"
    token_login = resp_login.json()["token"]

    # Follow-up GET
    headers_login = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token_login}"}
    resp_me_login = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/user/me"), headers=headers_login, timeout=10)
    assert resp_me_login.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp_me_login.status_code}: {resp_me_login.text}"
    assert resp_me_login.json()["user"] == username

def test_wallet_balance_and_topup():
    username, password, token = create_user()
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}

    # Initial balance
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["balance"] == 0

    # Topup
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/topup"), headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    new_balance = resp.json()["balance"]
    assert new_balance > 0

    # Verify balance
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["balance"] == new_balance

    # Topup again (conflict)
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/topup"), headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_wallet_transfer_success():
    _, _, token_a = create_user()
    _, _, token_b = create_user()

    headers_a = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token_a}"}
    headers_b = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token_b}"}

    # Topup A
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/topup"), headers=headers_a, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    balance_a_initial = resp.json()["balance"]

    # Get B's address
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers_b, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_b = resp.json()["address"]
    balance_b_initial = resp.json()["balance"]

    # Transfer A -> B
    transfer_amount = balance_a_initial / 2
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer"), headers=headers_a, json={"to": address_b, "amount": transfer_amount}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["balance"] == balance_a_initial - transfer_amount

    # Verify A's balance
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers_a, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["balance"] == balance_a_initial - transfer_amount

    # Verify B's balance
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers_b, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["balance"] == balance_b_initial + transfer_amount

def test_unauthorized_access():

    # Wallet transfer
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer"), json={"to": "some_address", "amount": 10}, timeout=10)
